description: Render carousel slides into branded PNG images (server-side, pixel-perfect) saved to the media library. Returns a render ID — poll get_carousel_render until 'completed'. Slide 1 uses the family's cover layout, the last slide its CTA layout, middle slides cycle content variants.

brandKitId.description: Brand kit id from list_brand_kits — applies its palette, fonts, logo, and handle (explicit values below still win; narrow with brandParts)

brandParts.description: With brandKitId: which kit parts to apply. Omitted object/keys default to true (apply everything) — set a key to false to skip that part

fonts.description: Apply the kit's font pairing (default true)

identity.description: Apply the kit's @handle / brand name (default true)

defaultImageUrl.description: Fallback https image for photo layouts when a slide has none

format.description: Output size: portrait 1080×1350 (default, IG/FB), square 1080×1080, square-lg 1200×1200 (LinkedIn), story 1080×1920 (TikTok photo mode)

handle.description: '@handle' meta text worked into covers and CTAs

logoUrl.description: https logo placed bottom-left on every slide

numbering.description: Add an 'i/N' position chip to each slide

paletteId.description: Palette id from list_carousel_styles (defaults to the family's suggested palette)

seamless.description: One wide mesh background sliced across all slides — swiping reveals a continuous panorama

seamlessSeed.description: Seed for the seamless mesh (same seed = same background)

slides.description: 2–10 slides, in order (from generate_carousel or hand-written)

body.description: Slide body (≤2000 chars; may be empty)

imageUrl.description: https image for this slide (used by photo layouts)

type.description: Slide role — 'title' pins the cover layout, 'cta' the CTA layout

name: render_carousel
